title: Closure-Based Rate Limiter
prompt:
Write `createLimiter(maxCalls)` that returns a function. The returned function returns `true` the first `maxCalls` times it is invoked and `false` after that.

Example with `createLimiter(2)`: `true, true, false, false, ...`

This is how click-debouncing and API throttling are usually structured — state captured in a closure, no globals.

tests.name: allows first N calls then blocks
tests.hint: Keep a let allowed = maxCalls in the closure; decrement on each call and compare.

tests.name: each limiter has its own budget
tests.hint: State must be created inside createLimiter — per call, not shared.
